overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds across the Montrose High Elevation zone today, driven by low overnight humidity and dry 1000-hr fuels.**
- The 7-day outlook stays flat at Moderate danger (ERC 56-58%, BI 50-52%) through Oct. 22, with no spikes expected.
- Today's min humidity of 20% exceeds the local watchout threshold (1 of 7 triggered); highs reach only into the low-50s with light north winds near 7 mph.
- A weak system brings cooling, rising humidity, and light rain (0.26") by Oct. 22, easing conditions late in the week.
- No Red Flag Warning or other NWS alerts are active for the area; skies stay sunny and calm through Saturday.
- BLM's Uncompahgre Field Office lifted Stage 1 fire restrictions on September 18, 2026, leaving only standard year-round rules in effect. Gunnison County rescinded all fire restrictions as of Sept. 18 as well.
- No new wildfires are reported in or near this area's counties in today's national incident report.
